findings.message: Entry param filtro has effect filter:listaTarefas but no state holds it. Added public state `filtro` (persisted in localStorage) that qryMinhasTarefas(filtro?, page, append) publishes and sends in the query input.

State selectedTarefa (select:detalheTarefa) had no setter. Added public `selectTarefa(id | null)`, which publishes selectedTarefa (kept in the URL param tarefaId) and loads the record into `tarefa` through qryTarefa.

No state has <command>.input as its source. Added drafts cmdCriarTarefaDraft (with generated chaveCriacao, prefilled by listaId/responsavelId params), cmdSalvarEdicaoDraft and cmdSalvarChecklistDraft (filled from the loaded task) and cmdDevolverDraft (return reason), with their setters; plus clearCmdCriarTarefaDraft to start a fresh creation key.

cmdCriarTarefa returns a TarefaDetalhe but the list holds TarefaResumo rows whose indicators (venceHoje, atrasada, quantidadeSubtarefas, progressoChecklist) cannot be computed in the browser. A created task is NOT inserted into `tarefas`; existing rows are updated only with the fields the detail carries (indicators keep their previous values) or removed when the filter no longer matches. After a creation or a checklist save the list indicators/membership may be stale until qryMinhasTarefas is called again.
